title: SECV_Tlajomulco: code and derived data for "Los límites de la mirada. Archivo fotogramétrico y transformación socioambiental"
description: Code and derived data for the book chapter "Los límites de la mirada" (Montes Ruiz and Bermeo Donoso), Seminario Permanente de Estudios de Cultura Visual, CEIICH-UNAM. Coverage analysis of the INEGI aerial survey index (SIIV, 2,074 records, six municipalities of the Guadalajara metropolitan area), cartographic regression of 1971 and 1993 aerial photographs of Tlajomulco de Zúñiga, Jalisco, Mexico, with prediction errors against a dated reference base, and JRC Global Surface Water and Landsat MSS series over the Presa La Playa basin. Includes the table of validated figures cited in the chapter, the scripts that regenerate it and a methodological note. INEGI photographs and Esri imagery are not included.
notes: Emilio José Bermeo Donoso carried out this work as a doctoral fellow of the Secretaría de Ciencia, Humanidades, Tecnología e Innovación (SECIHTI), Mexico. Data produced by the authors are licensed CC BY 4.0 (see LICENSE-DATA); third-party data remain under their original terms.
